known_data_limits: NavSatFix only exposes fix/no-fix; RTK fix_quality, satellite count, HDOP and receiver UTC are not published by the current gps_localization node.
Dual-antenna solution type/baseline are available in /rosout, not a substitute for positional RTK quality.
FOD_COMPLETE_STOP and visual completed mean crossing/stop, not confirmed physical pickup.
ROS1 mode services are not passively recorded as requests. Save supplied request bodies with the request command; GPS goals themselves are captured on topics.
No full-frame raw depth or raw RGB is recorded by this profile. Per-detection depth and compressed RGB are recorded.
Sweep status in mode status is protocol acknowledgement/timing, not hydraulic position feedback.
Obstacle bypass and continued driving require operator/video confirmation; navigation COMPLETE alone is insufficient.
No fixed numeric speed is specified in the supplied obstacle test case. Record configured limits separately from /odom actual speed.
Lux-meter photo, obstacle measurements/GPS, client-speed screenshot and 3-4 consecutive bypass pictures remain user-provided evidence; ROS bag alone does not fill these fields.
Chat receipt timestamps are reported times only. Pre-obstacle speed extraction requires an actual encounter timestamp from synchronized evidence.
